name: How do you ensure quality control during the final detail work phase?

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure quality control during the final detail work phase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quality control during final detail work involves a systematic approach, including comprehensive checklists and multiple inspections. Our project managers at Frasheski Construction conduct detailed walk-throughs to identify and resolve any remaining issues, such as paint blemishes, uneven trim, or faulty fixtures. We often involve the client in a preliminary walkthrough to gather feedback, which helps prioritize any last-minute adjustments and ensures their vision is perfectly realized.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quality control involves comprehensive checklists and multiple inspections by project managers, often including client feedback in preliminary walkthroughs.
